description: Explicit Artificial Analysis -> OpenRouter model identity mapping. Curated by humans: automatic matching must never silently extend this file. `status: confirmed` = identity verified against both live catalogs (AA model objects from the artificialanalysis.ai page payload and OpenRouter ids from /api/v1/models, refreshed 2026-09-03). `provisional` = plausible but unverified, surfaced in every run report. `aaModelId` is the Artificial Analysis model UUID from the AA page payload. `openrouterId` is the stable OpenRouter model id (no date suffix, no :variant, no ~ alias); the collector resolves the canonical date-suffixed slug at runtime via /api/v1/models. `undiscountedOpenrouterId`, when present, explicitly links a discounted tier to the OpenRouter model whose listed prices form the comparison line. NOTE: AA model slugs use dashes where names use dots (e.g. AA slug gpt-5-6-sol for GPT-5.6 Sol).
